empty.body: Ilyo mwashita ukufuma ku basellers ba Convergeo, ama-order no tracking fyaisa apa.
empty.title: Takwaba ama-order

errors.loadFailed: Tatwaishibe ukuleta ama-order yenu. Wesheni limbi.

escrow.cod: Lipileni mu cash ilyo mwapokelela order yenu.
escrow.held: Payment yenu yikwata bwino na Convergeo mpaka mupoke order yenu.
escrow.refunded: Refund ilebwelela ku mobile money wallet yenu.
escrow.released: Indalama shyasuminishwa ku vendor pantu fulfilment.

explain.placed: Twapokelela order yenu no kuitumina seller.
explain.paymentHeld: Indalama yenu yasungwa na Convergeo. Seller alipilwa fye pa numa ya delivery.
explain.paymentCod: Tapali indalama yashimbwa. Mulalipila mu cash ilyo mwapokelela order.
explain.confirmed: Seller asuminisha order yenu kabili alepekanya.
explain.ready: Order yenu yaipekanishiwa. Langeni code ya pickup kuli seller ilyo mwaya mukusenda.
explain.shipped: Order yenu ili na rider. Shalikeni foni ili on nga kuti amutumina.
explain.delivered: Order yenu yafika. Lolesheni ifintu fyenu, lyena suminisheni panshi.
explain.cancelled: Iyi order yafumishiwapo. Tumineni support nga tamwalecitenekela.
explain.refunded: Indalama yenu ileya ku mobile money wallet yenu.

pickup.title: Ifya pickup
pickup.qrLabel: Longeni QR code iyi kuli vendor
pickup.stubBody: QR na PIN ya pickup fikaboneka apa ilyo vendor alemarka order yikwete.

dispatch.title: Updates ya delivery
dispatch.empty: Ifya dispatch fikaboneka apa ilyo order yenu ileisa.

help.title: Mulefwaya ubwafwilisho pali iyi order?
help.beforeDispatch: Mulefwaya ukwaluka nangu ukufumyapo? Tumineni support na namba ya order ilyo tailatumwa.
help.afterDispatch: Kwaliba ubwafya na order yenu? Tumineni support na namba ya order.

doorPay.title: Lipileni pa mwinshi
doorPay.intro: Lipileni {amount} na mobile money ilyo rider ali pa mwinshi, napo mwapwisha ukumona ifintu fyenu.
doorPay.amountDue: Lipileni {amount} na mobile money pa mwinshi, napo mwapwisha ukumona ifintu fyenu.
doorPay.waitingRider: Akabatani ka kulipila kalaboneka apa ilyo rider aleta amashiwi ukuti afika.
doorPay.phoneHelp: Ukulomba kukaya kuli iyi nambala. Inambala sha Zamtel tashilapokelela nomba.
doorPay.pending: Moneni pa foni yenu no kwingisha PIN pa kusumina ukulipila.
doorPay.failed: Ukulipila takwapitile. Kuti mwaesha na kabili nangu ukubomfya nambala imbi.
doorPay.noAttemptsLeft: Tapali ukwesha na kumbi. Rider kuti apokelela indalama sha cash, ukufika pa mupaka.
doorPay.paid: Mwalipila. Ikodi yenu ya kupeela yaboneka pa muulu. Peeleni rider.
doorPay.cash: Lipileni rider {amount} mu cash, elyo mumupeele ikodi yenu ya kupeela.

errors.invalidPhone: Ingisheni nambala ya MTN nangu Airtel iya mu Zambia.
errors.operatorUnsupported: Iyi nambala taipokelela ukulomba. Bomfyeni nambala ya MTN nangu Airtel.
errors.inFlight: Ukulomba kwaliko kale pa foni yenu. Suminisheni nangu linda panono.
errors.generic: Pali icalubile. Moneni intaneti yenu elyo eseni na kabili.
